en: The image shows an old, sepia-toned postcard depicting a grand neoclassical building with a clock tower, dome, arched windows, and an ornate facade. There are groups of people in period clothing (late 19th or early 20th century) gathered in front of the building, suggesting a bustling urban setting. The building is labeled with inscriptions in Russian and German at the top, reading 'Почта и Телеграфъ' and 'Post und Telegraphenamt', which translate to 'Post and Telegraph Office'.
